reason: The copied muscle-protein instructions and ribosomes appear to be the pieces needed to make the pulling proteins.
expectation: The ribosomes should use the copied instructions to make muscle pulling proteins.

reason: The goal calls for giving the muscle cells their pulling structures, and the threads appear to be those structures.
expectation: The threads should fit into the cell model as its pulling structures.

effect: Adding the threads completed the muscle fibers. The picture shows that the filaments overlap more as the repeating unit shortens, while the filaments themselves keep their length.
reaction: The distinction between the shortening unit and unchanged filament lengths was interesting.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the pulling threads was most worthwhile because it brought the cell parts together and showed how their arrangement supports shortening.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making cell fluid from water and salts was straightforward but less engaging than seeing how the later structures work.

surprise.text: I found it useful that ribosomes and RNA are reused while amino acids become part of the new proteins.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the goals and item descriptions generally made the combinations understandable.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, because building the fibers made me curious how they will be organized into tissues and contribute to a working body.
